clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1.   Scope — Requirements for manufacture, dimensions and marking for fabricated PVC sockets for potable water suplies.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 2.  Requirements — The general requirements for materials, sizes, methods of test, sampling and criteria for conformity shall conform to IS 10124 (Part 1) : 1988.
